messages:
felix: quick FYI  saw a strange inversion on the latency panel for /v2/generate-stream in eu-central. p95 briefly below p50 around 13:47UTC. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/d/abc987 :grimacing:
maya: Can you paste the panel series config? sounds like mixed metric derivation or a composite metric bug.
felix: panel shows three series: p50 -> composite.median, p95 -> tdigest.quantile(0.95), p99 -> composite.quantile(0.99). The composite path is a new API that merges proxy+backend with fallback weights.
ron: ah that composite.median is a cross-node merge that uses histogram re-bucketing; composite.quantile uses a different merge heuristic. Mixing those with raw tdigest will definitely break monotonic ordering.
felix: raw queries snip: 
```
# p50 composite
GET /api/metrics/composite?metric=median&endpoint=/v2/generate-stream&region=eu-central
# p95 tdigest
SELECT quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('ingest') WHERE endpoint='/v2/generate-stream' AND region='eu-central' GROUP BY time(1m)
# p99 composite
GET /api/metrics/composite?metric=quantile.99&endpoint=/v2/generate-stream&region=eu-central
```
maya: we shouldn't show composite-derived medians next to tdigest quantiles. UX: either compute all from the same family or clearly annotate "composite vs raw" in legend.
dash-bot: created ticket UI-5201 "legend: surface derivation family for percentile series" by maya :memo:
ron: quick mitigation: change p50 to use tdigest median so all series use tdigest when available. I'll flip the panel.
felix: I pushed the change to the dashboard and deployed. dash-bot: dashboard deploy started by ron at 13:55UTC :rocket:
alerts-bot: alert MON-2123 triggered: panel monotonicity check failed (p50>p95) for /v2/generate-stream at 13:47UTC. Annotated in chart.
maya: infra note: composite API is returning low-resolution histograms for high-traffic nodes to save storage. That explains reconstruction artifacts. we should either store tdigest summaries in composite or mark composite-derived series as "approximate".
ron: For now, I've pointed all percentile series on that dashboard to tdigest sources where available. Deploy completed at 13:58UTC :white_check_mark:
felix: Chart looks correct now. p50 <= p95 <= p99. But we need a scan: find panels that reference "composite.*median" or "composite.quantile" alongside tdigest quantiles.
maya: I'll add a dashboard linter rule that errors when a panel mixes "composite" and "tdigest" series for the same endpoint and metric family. UI ticket UI-5201 will include the linter as a requirement.
ron: infra follow-up INFRA-3529: evaluate composite API to either return tdigest summaries or include explicit provenance metadata in responses.
ui-bot: proposal in UI-5201: add a small provenance pill in the legend (e.g., "p95  tdigest") and show sample_count + confidence band when N<20.
felix: sounds good. thanks everyone. leaving INFRA-3529/ UI-5201/ MON-2123 open. Closing thread for the dashboard change. :thumbsup:
